data.footage_size: 4,282 square feet (building size per LoopNet; unclear if Good Neighbor will occupy the full space or a portion)
data.short_description: Baltimore retail-and-cafe shop Good Neighbor is slated to open its first DC location at 429 8th Street SE. No opening timeline is available yet. The shop sells coffee, tea, and pastries alongside furniture, tableware, and bath and body products.

data.location: 209 E. Orangefair Mall, Unit 11, Fullerton, CA 92832
data.short_description: BAQBA Mexican Grill is preparing to open at 209 E. Orangefair Mall, Unit 11, in Fullerton. A plan review has been filed with the Orange County Health Department. The fast-casual chain currently operates a location in Rialto.

Loud'n Roasted is opening a cafe in the Woodland Park Crossing shopping center in the former Meanwhile Coffee space. The location is in its early phases, so no opening timeline can be projected. It will be the brand's third location, after Chantilly and Ashburn.
Meanwhile Coffee previously occupied the 2309 Woodland Crossing Drive space until it closed in August. Loud'n Roasted will take over the space.

Souplantation may reopen at 11179 Talbert Ave. in The Shoppes at Costco Plaza, and a plan review has been filed with the health department. No exact opening date has been announced. It would be the revived brand's third restaurant and its first in California since the 2020 closures.

Cafe Hin will open as a "daytime companion" to Hin bar, according to the brand's Instagram. No further details were available.

Sunrise Memphis will open its third location in a former AutoZone storefront in Germantown. A commercial alteration permit application is under review, and the opening is expected in late spring 2027.

data.short_description: Hawaiian donut shop Penny's Malasadas plans to open its first Las Vegas Valley shop in the Shops at Blue Diamond Durango center. Owner Andy Slikker says it will be an expanded version of its Waikiki anchor, with a glass display kitchen.
iWingz is planning a new restaurant in downtown Salem, and its website lists the location as coming soon. No opening date has been announced.

The iWingz at 25th Street SE closed on June 27 after about six and a half years because the business and the property owner could not agree on lease terms. The business has since served customers from its iWingz Mobile food truck.

data.location: The Belle Commons, Oxford Commons community, Oxford
data.short_description: Vicksburg's Rusty's Riverfront Grill is expanding to Oxford as Rusty's Oxford at The Belle Commons retail development. The Larsen family expects to be customer-ready by April of next year.

Lakeshore Kitchen, from Pearl West Restaurant Group owner Jorge Castro, is coming soon to 555 9th St NW in Salem. It will be the concept's second location after Vancouver, Washington, and no opening date has been announced.
Tradesman has applied for a Common Victualler License for a ground-floor lobby kiosk at Independence Wharf. It would be the Boston brand's newest location, with proposed hours of 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Happy Belly Food Group announced that Rosie's Burgers has secured a location in Mont-Tremblant, but has not disclosed an address or opening date. It will be operated by franchise partner Carma Hospitality and will be the fourth of its 10 committed Quebec units.

Foraging restaurant Morchella is returning as Morchella 2.0 and will run the kitchen at the new Double Down Lounge. Chefs Cameron Dunlap and David Stevenson have partnered with bar owners Jake and Shela Kagan.

Jake and Shela Kagan leased the former 3 Doors Down restaurant space to open a neighborhood bar called The Double Down Lounge. It will feature a DJ booth, a large TV showing "Soul Train," and a rotating art gallery, with Morchella 2.0 running the kitchen.

data.event_date: Not specified (photo caption says "later this year"; opening date still being determined)

data.status: preparing to sweeten up Philadelphia with its first-ever location; will debut

Buren Bakery will also open a location in Puerto Rico. No address or timeline is provided.

Fuel Coffee's Montlake location will reopen as Taru Coffee & Play under new owner Filisha Shah. Most of the space will be devoted to The Grove, an indoor play area for children ages 1 to 5. The café will continue serving Stamp Act coffee with pastries and an expanded food menu.

data.status: grand opening celebration is scheduled for this Friday, October 23

This location is part of the same three-restaurant San Antonio expansion. It is expected to open in March 2027.

Guru's Elevated Indian Dining has been under construction for the last year at the former Kerby's Koney Island location. It will feature a dining area, bar and lounge, and management has started hiring.

51st Deli is listed for a 2027 opening in the former Fat Kat Slims space in the Gulch. The Nashville-based deli currently lists four Tennessee-area locations.
